I routed this to Dunlin-235B based on capability scores. This is a straightforward text-editing/wording task, which falls under general writing — closest to the "Creative Generation" and "Summarization" eval categories. Dunlin scores higher across essentially every benchmark and internal eval (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 78.8, plus stronger IFEval and Arena-Hard, which track instruction-following and writing quality). 

Since there's nothing sensitive about this query, the safety/moderation specialization of either model isn't a factor, and the task-preference notes don't apply. So the decision came down to raw capability, where Dunlin has a clear edge.
